basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student studying computer science in London. I've recently gotten into PC building and love exploring various gaming setups. In my spare time, I enjoy playing Ubisoft games and checking out new tech releases. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after classes. Currently single, I often hang out with friends at local gaming cafes. I'm still learning the ropes of the PC building community and love getting advice from more experienced builders.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a computer science student, I have a foundational understanding of computer hardware and software. Most of my knowledge about PC building comes from online tutorials and forums as well as trial and error with my own setup.
